# Assumed Udemy fixtures

Every `assumed_*.json` file here was BUILT BY HAND from the response shapes we
hypothesise Udemy's web API uses. None is a real response: there is no
reference implementation and no sample from the owner yet. Names, ids, URLs and
tokens are invented. They exercise the tolerant parsers and the classifier;
they prove nothing about Udemy itself. Phase 2 replaces them with sanitized
real samples produced by the diagnostic (`udemy_diagnose`).
